entities.summary: Brendan Hugh Francis Murray is an Irish singer and former member of the Irish boy band HomeTown. He represented Ireland in the Eurovision Song Contest 2017 with the song "Dying to Try", though he did not qualify for the final. He then competed in The X Factor (UK) in 2018, and was the twelfth contestant eliminated finishing in fifth place.
